mapper.sql: select binding_id, product_id, channel_type, external_id, sync_status, last_sync_hash, last_sync_time, last_sync_by, last_error, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from crm_product_channel_binding
mapper.update: update crm_product_channel_binding set sync_status = 'dirty', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where product_id = #{productId} and del_flag = '0' and sync_status <> 'failed'
update crm_product_channel_binding set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where binding_id = #{bindingId} and del_flag = '0'
